description: Performance of the live app on the machine it was measured on
command: LUMEN_G8_OUT=<file> npx playwright test -c e2e/playwright.real.config.ts livePerf
notes: siteSwitchMs is click to the engine's new numbers on screen, end to end (worker evaluation included), headless Chromium.
hoverToFrameMs is pointer event to the next animation frame; it is dominated by the 60 Hz frame wait and is NOT the 4 ms pointer-to-overlay-drawn measurement of the old harness.
slipDragFrameMs is the frame time while dragging the slip slider; 16.7 ms is one 60 Hz frame (no dropped frames).
Scan and Quick Answer are not part of the live pages, so they cannot be timed there.
This machine is not confirmed to be the demo laptop.
